versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.15

- Updated skill version metadata to 1.0.15 in SKILL.md.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to functionality, prompts, or agent behavior.  
- Documentation and install instructions remain as before.

- Version bump to 1.0.14 in SKILL.md (from 1.0.13).
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No functional or workflow changes—documentation and versioning update only.

Version 1.0.13

- Updated SKILL.md content to reflect latest guidance and routing for related skills (notably p-video-2-pro and p-video-2).
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to API or usage instructions.

p-image 1.0.12

- Updated references from `p-video` to `p-video-2` where appropriate for video routing and skill recommendations.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.
- No changes to API, usage, or prompt craft.

- Version bumped to 1.0.11.
- Documentation updated in SKILL.md with no content changes detected except metadata version increment.
- skill-card.md file removed.

p-image 1.0.10

- Updated version metadata to 1.0.10 in SKILL.md.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- No functional or interface changes to prompts or APIs.

**Clarified routing and use case for `p-image` vs. `p-image-ideogram`.**

- Made it explicit that `p-image` is for the fastest, cheapest photo generation, not for photoreal, text-in-image, or structured outputs.
- Added guidance on when to use `p-image-ideogram` or other related skills instead.
- Updated agent instructions for clearer routing and first-reply intake.
- Streamlined and expanded the "When NOT to use" section with new comparison language.
- Removed obsolete reference file (skill-card.md).

p-image 1.0.8

- Updated skill version to 1.0.8 in documentation.
- First reply pattern now calls for open intake using `generation-diversity` for clarification, aligning prompt intake to latest standards.
- Minor edit to agent habit section for clarity and intake alignment.
- Removed redundant or outdated documentation file: skill-card.md.

- Major refactor: streamlined documentation and consolidated prompts and scenario guidance to core skills.
- Added explicit prerequisites section, instructing to install and use `generation-diversity`, `image-prompting`, and `pruna-api` skills before generating images.
- Moved detailed prompting, generation diversity, photoreal persona, and scenario matrix rules into shared skills and guides; this skill now refers out, not repeats.
- Removed standalone references and checklists for diversity, prompt quality, seed rituals, and persona scenarios.
- Clarified agent habits: confirm model, credential, and prompt with user up front, always following prompt fidelity rules.
- Expanded related/next-step skills table in markdown for paste-friendly install guidance.

p-image 1.0.6

- Updated documentation links to use new `/references/policies/` directory and centralized shared documentation.
- Added a "Shared generation policy" section outlining required quality and diversity steps before running image generation.
- Shortened and clarified the description for broader, more accessible use cases.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Revised references and examples to ensure consistency with new documentation structure.

- Dropped reference and recommendation for the "p-image-ideogram" skill; now focused solely on p-image for fast text-to-image needs.
- Clarified that dense readable typography is not supported; prompts should avoid copy-heavy scenes.
- Minor updates to documentation for clarity and focus, removing unnecessary alternate suggestions and extra workflow descriptions.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

**Expanded documentation, clarified usage, and updated quality guidance for p-image skill.**

- Rewrote documentation to highlight "good quality, extremely fast" generation, and clarified that p-image is fastest for bulk/draft/mood board stills—not the best for photoreal hero plates.
- Added explicit guidance on when NOT to use this skill, with clear links to alternative skills for photoreal images, editing, or try-on.
- Updated references and examples: improved prompt examples, removed recommendations to pass seed except for reproducibility, and added a self-contained example prompt file.
- Removed obsolete files (pspm.json, skill-card.md), updated references, and improved navigation to related workflows.
- Revised checklists and instructions for production quality outputs, diversity, and realism for downstream tasks.

- Initial release of the p-image skill for Pruna.
- Provides extremely fast, good-quality text-to-image generation optimized for speed and low latency over maximum photorealism.
- Ideal for mood boards, draft stills, and fast bulk panel creation.
- Supports both asynchronous (recommended) and synchronous modes via Pruna P-API.
- Detailed guidance on input options, best practices, scenario planning, and integration with related skills for image editing, try-on, upscaling, and animation.

- Initial release of the p-image skill for ultra-fast text-to-image generation via Pruna.
- Supports both asynchronous (recommended) and quick synchronous generation methods.
- Allows customizable parameters: prompt, aspect_ratio, seed, and advanced options.
- Includes best practices for prompt engineering, scenario coverage, and quality checks.
- Provides guidance for downstream workflows: editing, try-on, upscaling, and video/animation integration.
